## 13 — Slanted marginal diagram and all local labels

Crop `readers/026/A/crop_08_margin.png`; SHA-256 `a7a4f1848f5483eea3f1c45dafae9bd875e6d27098e4bdebf6afe460724ee220`. Loci: L015, L016, L017, L018, L019, S15, S16.

L015: the upright crop shows diagramme above a densely crossed upper label; below it, two filled endpoints are joined by one slightly bowed segment. A small detached point sits below the segment. The lower line contains Sigma-minus, a doubled-bottom right-opening relation, E with a looped lower-right return, a left-opening subset, and Sigma-plus. Reproduce the entire B026-DIAG literal source as the selected drawing: its individual runs retain both detached Sigma heads, the actual doubled relation, the E upper arm and return, the point, and the filled endpoints. Retain the 52-degree page slant and the existing margin placement. Mark the selected diagram in place as unsure, while the source comments and public local rows retain the complete component states below. Layout, segment/endpoints and diagramme are high confidence; his hand except the independently qualified point/run candidates.

L016: the crossed upper label has a vertical left portion, upper and lower right chambers and several superposed bars. B is the primary recoverable letter from those chambers; E and Sigma remain supported alternatives under the overtrace. Record the order deleted B / deleted E / deleted Sigma. Keep the B literal crossed paths once. C026-R05 remains retained, medium confidence for the letter and high for cancellation.

L017: the E has a detached short upper run and a long lower foot that turns into a small lower-right loop and outgoing tail. The alpha index and an E-foot flourish remain alternative assignments of that same loop. For each, retain both upper-arm/head and independent-upper-run states, yielding four complete local readings in this order: E_alpha with detached top arm; E with lower-right flourish and detached top arm; E_alpha with independent upper run; E with lower-right flourish and independent upper run. Body and loop are his hand; only the independent-upper-run component is undetermined hand under that state. Keep B's literal upper run, middle arm, stem and shared return. C026-R06 remains retained for alpha versus flourish. Confidence medium.

L018: the right-opening relation has a curved upper return and a heavy separate low horizontal run. Supseteq is primary, with superset plus an extra lower retrace as the alternative; both retain the same two literal paths. Preserve the order supseteq / superset and all visible strokes. Confidence medium; his hand.

L019: the small rounded point below the segment is detached from the segment and the lower label. Retain B's actual point at its relative position, with hand, role, attachment and surface origin undetermined. Confidence medium for the point's interpretation; its presence is clear.

S15 and S16 each have a short horizontal run visibly detached above the zigzag body. The left superscript is minus and the right superscript is plus. Retain both complete C local head/retrace-versus-independent-run states for each sign, with all role/attachment/hand fields unchanged, while selecting B's literal paths. Main bodies and signs are his hand; the independent upper run has undetermined hand only in that candidate. Confidence medium for head attribution, high for the signs.

The complete root diagram states preserve A's twelve letter/relation/E-loop combinations under the explicit reordered axes B,E,Sigma; supseteq,superset; E_alpha,E-with-flourish, and append the independently retained head roles of E, S15 and S16. Keep the tuple-to-complete-reading map explicit, with 3×2×2×2×2×2 = 96 ordered complete combinations and candidate-specific component hands. No stroke is omitted, duplicated, or assigned a new mathematical operation.

## 19 — Two pairs, distinctes deletion and de X insertion

Crop `readers/026/A/crop_14_pairs_correction.png`; SHA-256 `314e5683303b1d061460fab369e36e80b099eef58831d25f1700e4954fc85872`. Loci: L029, S17, S18, L030, S19, S20, L031, L032.

L029: the first pair has curly braces and the second has the separately qualified opener and a clear closing curly brace. Their comma separator is visible. The correction has a long guide curving upward from beneath the first pair and continuing below the second toward the crossed word; de X, sits below the pairs. Preserve the whole A026-G08 arrangement, the guide, the two pairs and the insertion, with the local decisions below.

S17, first plus term, has a joined upper head and the lower index1 with upper plus. Keep A026-S17 exactly, high confidence. S18, S19 and S20 have detached short upper runs above their respective bodies; the lower indices are1,2,2 and the upper signs are minus,plus,minus. Keep each exact A local two-state head/retrace-versus-independent-run set and its literal paths, medium confidence for head attribution and high for indices/signs. Main glyphs are his hand; only each independent short run has undetermined hand in that candidate.

L030: the second opener has a short upper return, curved upright stem and a short lower return. Retain A026-G09's exact drawing and square-bracket/round-parenthesis states in that order, medium confidence; his hand. Its right closer remains the visible curly brace. Original C026-R13 is retained.

L031: the crossed word retains the initial d portion, the tall t strokes, the c turn and terminal es despite several diagonal cancellations. The word is distinctes and is cancelled. Resolve A's single-word qualification to deleted{distinctes}, as in B/C's selected content, while preserving the cancellation and its position. Confidence high; his hand. C026-R08 is resolved.

L032: de is below the guide at the left of the large X, and a comma follows X. Preserve inserted{de X,} in A's complete placement. Confidence high; his hand.

Update the two A parent candidates only for the resolved distinctes word, and retain each local S18-S20 two-state scope independently. The explicit complete parent expansion has16 tuples in the order opener [/(, then the recorded S18,S19,S20 head-role axes; S17 and all other selected words/signs remain fixed. Every tuple retains the local candidate-specific hand fields.
